# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
- **Severity:** SEV1. checkout-web 5xx/error rate peaked at 17.6% (threshold for SEV1 is >10% of checkout traffic).
- **Start:** 14:03Z (checkout-web errors and payments-api p99 onset).
- **Mitigated:** ~14:29Z (flag reverted; metrics confirmed recovery).
- **Status:** Verified recovered. checkout-web errors 0.4% at 14:29Z; payments-api p99 450 ms at 14:30Z (baseline ~420 ms).

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:15: cfg_0412, tax-service DB connection pool 50 -> 80 (jsato). Not confirmed as a factor; in window but no matching errors.
- 13:41: dep_7781, payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0. No errors correlated.
- 14:02: flg_2210, `tax_engine_v2` rollout 10% -> 100% (release-train). Enables TaxEngineV2 calls to tax-service `/v2/quote` for all checkout traffic.
- 14:02:31: payments-api begins logging TaxEngineV2 timeouts (3000 ms) on `/v2/quote`.
- 14:03: tax-service logs "/v2/quote p99 3021ms; shedding load". checkout-web and payments-api p99 (3150 ms) onset.
- 14:04 onward: payments-api `POST /charge 502: tax quote unavailable (TaxEngineV2)`.
- 14:05: dep_7790, search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1. search-api p99 rose 310 -> 430 ms, then 330 ms. No search-api errors; not the cause of checkout errors.
- 14:08: tax-service logs "/v2/quote worker pool exhausted".
- 14:21: Incident response began. Alerts: payments-api p99, checkout-web 5xx, search-api p95 (warning).
- 14:28: Flag `tax_engine_v2` set 100% -> 10% (previous rollout). Status page: identified.
- 14:29: checkout-web error rate 0.4%; payments-api p99 450 ms.
- 14:33: Status page: mitigated.

## Root cause
The `tax_engine_v2` ramp to 100% (flg_2210) sent all checkout traffic through TaxEngineV2, which calls tax-service `/v2/quote`. tax-service could not handle that load: p99 rose above 3 s, it began shedding load, and its worker pool was exhausted. payments-api calls timed out after 3000 ms, returning 502 on `/charge`, which failed checkouts. The timing (14:02 change, 14:03 onset) and the logs (TaxEngineV2 timeouts, tax-service load-shedding) both match this change. The search-api deploy (14:05) and the payments deploy (13:41) do not match the error pattern.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` back to 10%, its previous rollout, per the incident runbook (least risky first, before any rollback). Chosen over a deploy rollback because the flag was the change that caused the errors and the deploy had no matching errors. Effective ~2 minutes after the change.

## Verification
- checkout-web error_rate_pct: 17.6% -> 0.4% (14:29).
- payments-api p99_latency_ms: 3150 ms -> 450 ms (14:29-14:30), baseline ~420 ms.
- Alerts: alt_31 (payments-api p99) and alt_32 (checkout-web 5xx) cleared. alt_33 (search-api p95 warning) remains; search-api p99 is 330 ms vs baseline ~310 ms, with no errors. Judged unrelated; monitor.

## Open items / follow-ups
- The `tax_engine_v2` flag is at 10%, not 100%. Do not re-ramp until tax-service `/v2/quote` capacity is confirmed (tax-platform).
- Investigate why tax-service `/v2/quote` could not absorb the load at 100%, and whether it had a capacity or dependency issue (tax-platform). Note that cfg_0412 (DB pool change at 13:15) is in the window; it has not been shown to be a factor.
- payments-api should add a fallback or circuit breaker for TaxEngineV2 timeouts so tax-service overload does not fail checkouts (payments).
- Review the release-train process for ramping flags to 100% without a load check (release owners).
- search-api warning (alt_33): keep watching; no errors observed.

## Communications
- Status page: SEV1 `identified` (14:28Z), SEV1 `mitigated` (14:33Z).
- Paged `payments` (high) and `tax-platform` (high).
